register.name: M0MTB_POSITION
register.comment: Contains the trace write pointer and the wrap bit.

register.name: M0MTB_MASTER
register.comment:
Contains:
 The main trace enable bit.
 Other trace control fields.

register.name: M0MTB_FLOW
register.comment:
Contains:
 The WATERMARK address.
 The AUTOSTOP and AUTOHALT control bits.

register.name: M0MTB_BASE
register.comment: Indicates where the SRAM is located in the processor memory map. This register is provided to enable auto discovery of the MTB SRAM location, by a debug agent.
